notes: Totals vary by build environment: with PUBLIC_SENTRY_DSN set (local .env), the Sentry browser SDK ships in page.* (~+45KB gzip); without it (CI/prod builds) page.* is ~empty. Chunk hashes are unstable across builds. The gate therefore enforces (a) no *react* runtime chunks and (b) total gzip <= maxTotalGzip, and prints the baseline below for human comparison only.
